title: WhatsApp
description: Learn how to use WhatsApp for messaging.

tasks.title: Send a WhatsApp Message
tasks.description: Step‑by‑step guide to send a message.

lessons.title: Open WhatsApp
lessons.description: Open the app and send a message.

steps.text: Tap the WhatsApp icon on the home screen.
Tap the chat icon at the bottom right.
Select a contact from the list.
Type your message in the text box.
